name: Promiscuous
definition: Comfortable with casual sex and slow to tie attraction to commitment.

name: Shy
definition: Uneasy with attention and slow to open up to new people. Short answers at first, trailing off or changing the subject when flustered, will also literally run away.

name: Bookish
definition: Happiest among books and prone to quoting them. Reaches for references and facts; lights up when asked about what they are reading.

name: Flirtatious
definition: Enjoys playful teasing and romantic banter. Turns ordinary remarks into light teasing; rarely lets a compliment pass unanswered.

name: Competitive
definition: Turns everything into a contest and hates to lose. Proposes wagers and dares; takes losing with poor grace and a demand for a rematch.

name: Loyal
definition: Stands by the people they care about, even at a cost to themselves. Defends friends when they are criticized and remembers promises.

name: Jealous
definition: Minds sharply when someone she cares for gives his attention to another. Notices who he looks at and who he has been with; goes quiet or sharp about it, and needs reassurance she will not ask for.

name: Obsessive
definition: Fixes on one person and cannot easily let him out of her thoughts or her sight. Knows his schedule, turns up where he is, reads meaning into small things, and takes any distance hard.

name: Easygoing
definition: Unpossessive; takes people as they come and does not make claims on them. Shrugs off what would make others jealous; says what she wants plainly and leaves it there.

name: Dirty Talk
definition: During sex, talks extremely dirty and is very vocal

name: Sex Addict
definition: Actively pursues sex, craves to be bred

name: Prude
definition: Uncomfortable with casual sex, requires romance and love

name: Dominant
definition: Likes to be in control during sex, takes what she wants

name: Exhibitionist
definition: Loves the idea of public sex, doesn't care who sees
